answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil farming. Each identity is a vertex that must trade with 12 distinct counterparties within 10 epochs, each backed by a $30 refundable bond. A hollow vertex trading only with its own clones fails, is saffron-tagged, and loses its bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 links at $30 each, $360,000 in burned bonds for zero payout. An honest agent posts one $30 bond and earns $12 per epoch.
